Maya: Quick sync  late window tonight 02:00 UTC. Runtime v2.5.1 -> canary then ramp. Need API + router + console coord.
Ravi: I'll pin API at 01:50 UTC to canary 3%. Will observe for 10m.
Sam: Console will run a 3-step smoke: login, config-save, small-eval at 01:40 staging -> 01:55 prod. I'll flip feature flag 'rt-v2' for canary only.
Maya: Router: staged config ready. We'll mirror API weight. Abort if 5xx >0.7% for 5m.
ops-bot: Added rollback criteria to thread: sustained 5xx >1% for 10m OR p95 +180ms for 5m OR auth failures. Runbook: https://grafana.redwood/runbooks/cutover-rollback
deploy-bot: Scheduled: runtime v2.5.1 canary at 2024-06-20T02:00:00Z. Manual rollback only.
Ravi: Pin command example run at 01:50: `/deploy pin --service api --version v1.14.2 --wave canary --pct 3`
Maya: Keep posts short. On rollback, ping @oncall and run `/deploy rollback <service> <version>`
Sam: Staging smoke green. Flipped flag in staging.
Ravi: Pin applied in staging. Monitoring now.
Maya: Ops dashboard: https://grafana.redwood/d/abcd/cutover. Will post if alerts.
Ravi: API metrics OK at +2m. Preparing prod pin.
